Manifest.Name: 最佳报价 / Best Offer
Manifest.Author: Naki & Codex
Manifest.Description: 智能选货、一键摆货与售卖快捷键、库存与分类售卖规则。保留原版价格、预算和结算。 点击右侧齿轮设置快捷键，与店铺的「交易设置」同步。界面随游戏语言切换中英文。 Smart offers, placement and quick-sell hotkeys, inventory and category rules. Original economy preserved. Use the gear to change hotkeys; Trade Settings stays in sync. Chinese/English UI follows the game language.
